likely_cause_en: Missing/unresolved Customer object passed into OrderService.charge, likely from an upstream lookup or auth binding failure
Malformed/invalid date string ('2026-13-40') fed into ReportScheduler's date parser, likely from an upstream data source using an incorrect date format (e.g. day-month swap or corrupted field).
Upstream webhook sender is emitting JSON with a trailing comma, violating strict JSON syntax
User account had insufficient balance at time of payment attempt (expected business condition, not a system defect).
API token/credential missing the payouts.write OAuth scope
Slow or resource-constrained ClickHouse query against a large/unoptimized events_raw table
An Elasticsearch data node holding shard 3 of the orders-2026.09 index is down or unreachable, causing the search phase to fail across all shards for that query.
Heap memory exhaustion in the batch ledger worker, likely from an oversized flush batch, a memory leak, or undersized JVM heap configuration.
Sustained unavailability or unresponsiveness of the downstream service/dependency that RetryWorker is calling, causing every retry attempt to time out.
Three unrelated, isolated component-level errors rather than a single systemic root cause; insufficient log volume to identify a common trigger.
Persistent upstream/network timeout causing continuous Poller retries, compounded by a separate heap memory exhaustion in the payments LedgerWorker flush path.
